card.line: Tirzah was an old Canaanite city that later became a royal home for the kings of northern Israel, where kings reigned, fell, and died.

moments.title: A king of Tirzah is defeated
moments.text: The king of Tirzah is listed as one of thirty-one kings defeated in the land.

moments.title: Jeroboam's son dies
moments.text: Jeroboam's wife went to Tirzah. As soon as she stepped over the threshold of the house, the boy died.

moments.title: Baasha rules from Tirzah
moments.text: When Baasha learned of Ben-hadad's attack, he stopped fortifying Ramah and withdrew to Tirzah. He reigned there twenty-four years.

moments.title: Zimri kills Elah
moments.text: King Elah was in Tirzah getting drunk when his servant Zimri conspired against him. Zimri killed him and reigned in his place.

moments.title: Omri besieges Tirzah
moments.text: Omri and the Israelites marched up and besieged Tirzah. When Zimri saw the city was captured, he burned the royal palace down upon himself.
